prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: a candidate landscape editorial cover for an article called How to Read a Teleprompter Naturally on iPhone; preview for approval.
Input image role: the attached image is a visual reference for convincing everyday smartphone filming photography and a teleprompter camera preview. Create an original wide photographic adaptation of that concept, not a recreation of the reference collage or its exact person.
Primary request: make this much more realistic than a stylized illustration. A candid, close photograph of one black smartphone in landscape orientation, properly secured in a simple compact desk-tripod clamp, with its screen facing the viewer. The phone occupies most of the frame, large and sharp enough to read as a real physical object. On the screen, a fictional adult creator with naturally curly dark hair, a plain dark shirt and realistic skin texture speaks calmly toward the phone's front-facing camera, seated in a modest naturally lit home office. Her face and upper torso appear in the camera preview, her eyes near the lens. She holds a small wired microphone close to her mouth with anatomically natural fingers. She is visible on the phone display only, not duplicated elsewhere in the photograph. This is a photograph of a creator's phone screen, not a person looking at the back of a phone.
Screen content: a subtle translucent dark prompt area on the left half with a few ordinary white sans-serif script lines. Exact text: "Before you record,\ncheck your framing.\n\nSpeak to one person.\nPause between thoughts." Keep her eyes, nose and mouth clear on the right half. The overlay is generic and unbranded, with only a small simple recording indicator if useful. Do not imply this is a screenshot of Teleprompter Pal or reproduce another app's branding. The glass has faint believable reflections while the display remains legible.
Composition: single continuous photograph, wide 16:9 landscape crop suitable for a blog cover, one phone only, include the full intact phone silhouette and the top of its actual tripod below; subtly blurred neutral home-office background, no devices cut off awkwardly. No collage, no split screen, no title banner, no headline outside the screen. Use the practical, unpolished credibility of the reference, with natural window light, neutral color balance, restrained contrast, fine sensor grain, real glass and rubber textures and small everyday imperfections. Crisp phone and screen, realistic depth of field. No cinematic purple glow, no illustration, no glossy 3D rendering, no floating UI, no extra cameras, no impossible phone anatomy, no duplicated hands, no logos, no watermarks.
